realizes.rationale: Declares all 76 admitted languages (19 pypi_wheel including the 15 core pilots, 56 language_pack entries, and builtin_lean) with pinned wheel SHA-256 hashes, tagsQuerySha256 digests, explicit guaranteeTier values, qualifier specs, and ambiguous suffixes.

Declares the schema-validated global hash-pinned catalog lock with exact PyPI wheel SHA-256 hashes, query SHA-256 digests, wrappers, destructuring specs, reserved suffixes, ambiguous suffixes, and languagePack pin.

1.note: The lockfile pins `schema` (`ar-language-catalog/v1`), `treeSitter` version `0.26.1` (`minAbi: 13`, `maxAbi: 15`), reserved `.lean`, ambiguous suffixes (including `.h`, `.m`, `.v`, `.scm`), `tree-sitter-language-pack==0.13.0` wheels, and 76 uniform `languages` entries (19 `pypi_wheel`, 56 `language_pack`, and `builtin_lean`) with `guaranteeTier`, `qualifiers`, and SHA-256 query pins.
